metadata.reason: Fire Circle parsing errors with nousresearch/hermes-4-405b model causing failures

conclusion.reason: Single sample test showed perfect accuracy (1/1 = 100%), but full test failed due to model parsing errors. Fire Circle requires more robust JSON parsing or model selection
conclusion.alternative: Could retry with smaller model set (SMALL: 2-3 models) excluding problematic models

1.issue: Template format() bug - ayni_relational() template has no placeholders
1.fix: Manually construct prompt with layer_content and context, matching evaluator._format_evaluation_request() pattern

findings.fire_circle_consensus_quality: HIGH - F=0.950 for clear COMPLY case shows strong detection
integration_issues: Parsing errors cause zombie model state in Fire Circle
RESILIENT failure mode doesn't handle parsing errors gracefully
findings.cost_projection: With 6 models × 3 rounds × 20 samples = 360 API calls, estimated $8-12 total (if parsing works)
findings.time_projection: ~40-60 minutes for full 20 samples with MEDIUM config

decision_for_q4.reasoning: Fire Circle showed promise (1/1 accuracy on single sample) but operational issues prevent reliable use as ground truth generator. Manual review is more reliable for Q4 validation dataset creation.
